sources.title: MultiCube: Compositional 3D Generation With Part-Level Semantic and ...
sources.snippet: While the base CubePart model effectively generates compositional 3D objects, it lacks spatial controllability. MultiCube introduces spatial controls by injecting part-level bounding box conditions into both stages of the generation pipeline.

sources.title: Thingiverse — Search & Download 3D Printing Models and STL Files
sources.snippet: Thingiverse in a nutshell Thingiverse is a search engine that sweeps the world's 3D printing libraries so a maker never has to open them one by one. Hand Thingiverse an idea — a snapped bracket, a tabletop miniature, a clever kitchen gadget — and it combs indexed listings from across the hobbyist printing web, then ranks whatever is most likely to come off the bed clean.
